name: HealthSearchQA
intro: HealthSearchQA是Google在MultiMedQA论文中新引入的自由回答医学问题数据集，包含3173个来自健康搜索引擎的消费者医疗问题，旨在评估大型语言模型在真实用户健康查询场景中的表现。
build_method_en: Automatically generated, from health search engine queries
eval_feature_en: Evaluates LLM knowledge and reasoning ability in consumer health query scenarios
intro_en: HealthSearchQA is a free-response medical question dataset newly introduced by Google in the MultiMedQA paper. It contains 3,173 consumer health questions from health search engines and aims to evaluate large language models' performance in real-world user health query scenarios.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2212.13138. HealthSearchQA is introduced as the consumer-health component of MultiMedQA. It is curated from seed medical conditions and associated symptoms; those seeds retrieve publicly available commonly searched health questions generated by a search engine and shown to users entering the seed terms. The resulting dataset contains 3,375 open-domain consumer medical questions with free-text response format. In the MultiMedQA evaluation framework, model answers on HealthSearchQA are evaluated with clinician axes such as scientific consensus, possible harm, comprehension, retrieval, reasoning, inappropriate or missing content, and bias, with additional lay-user utility judgments for consumer-facing answers.
